latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video Mod — turn still images into animated video clips in seconds.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) and convert them into 1080p MP4 video clips, ready for download and sharing.
- User-friendly, streamlined workflow: no manual editing, no complex animation tools required.
- Automatic backend connection and token management for quick setup (100 free credits for new users).
- Handles prompt-based actions like video generation, export, credit checking, and session management via a cloud GPU render pipeline.
- Supports batch editing, iterative previews, and detailed timeline summaries for efficient content creation.
- Comprehensive error handling with clear guidance for file size, format, credits, and export permissions.
